Definition / Rule: Designer feedback: greater variety of instruments and musical styles. Beefcakes should include hard rock / metal inspiration. Retain mystery, adventure, developed melodies and the serious story beneath comedy.
Notes: Crosspath v02 received 'much better'; use as the direction reference, not final approval.

Definition / Rule: Expanded palette: recorded electric guitar, electric bass, acoustic drum kit, upright bass and baritone sax; woodwinds, piano, strings and natural percussion; modeled organ/banjo colors. Synth atmosphere remains subtle.
Notes: Selected CC0 Karoryfer and Virtuosity recordings packaged with pinned sources, hashes and licenses. Modeled organ and banjo are original generated instruments. LMMS 1.2.2; no paid installs.

Definition / Rule: Use developing melody, counterlines, varied voicing, contrasting sections and breathing space.
Notes: Do not meet a duration target by copying a short phrase repeatedly.

Definition / Rule: Whimsical young-adult fantasy and dry character humor; serious story beneath.
Notes: Humor through musical timing and color. No comic ornament over grief, captivity or major revelations.

Definition / Rule: Propulsive without rushing card decisions; quieter contrasting sections reduce fatigue.
Notes: One battle song per dungeon, used for ordinary/elite and non-main boss encounters. Separate main/final-dungeon boss scores retained. Preserve redundant music IDs as compatibility aliases. Listen over repeated loops with dialogue and game sounds.

Definition / Rule: Different motifs and instrument colors belong together without being forced identical.
Notes: Primm compresses diversity into rigid order; liberation restores individual character.

Definition / Rule: Rock / melodic metal-inspired riffs, electric bass and acoustic drums; horn answers and clean-guitar bridges. Story and shop arrangements can be gentler. Strong and brave without cartoon scoring.
Notes: Clench constricts the groove; Flex restores breath and generosity.

Definition / Rule: Kitchen rock with up-tempo jazz brass, piano, guitar, walking bass and driving jazz/rock drums. Organized interlocking pots, pans and utensil percussion; busy controlled fills. Escalate intensity through dungeons and main boss; quieter story/shop variations.
Notes: The impostor borrows polish without warmth; the true Chef restores generous phrasing.

Definition / Rule: Dark orchestral exploration: bowed strings, low woodwinds and organ, with faster, livelier short-bow passages. Intense gothic rock fights: strings/organ themes over electric guitar, bass and driving drums.
Notes: The faction is not evil. Mortimer blocks resolution; Agnes lets the phrase finish.

Definition / Rule: Violin-led folk with piano. Initially semi-unsettling: interrupted pulse, unresolved phrases and a corruption intrusion. Battles are upbeat and intense; the main boss ramps up tempo, violin runs and drums. Restoration recovers harmony.
Notes: Rotheart crowds the texture; healing restores space and decay.

Definition / Rule: One original singable theme fragments across the four memories; full statement at the throne.

Definition / Rule: A sincere civic melody with too-perfect rhythm; grows coercive and fractures in phase 3.
